'''Scoundrels''' is the first of three releases of [[Virtual Block 8]], a legacy virtual expansion. Its text is official as of 11 May 2012.<ref name="pdf" /> The release has 49 cards: 25 Dark Side and 24 Light Side.

[[File:Set-VB8.1-announcement-banner.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Announcement banner, April 2012.]]
Scoundrels was announced on 14 April 2012.<ref name="ann81">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=335&catid=1&Itemid=117 Scoundrels 8.1 Annoucement], starwarsccg.org (14 April 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20120818111311/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=335&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive].</ref> Its banner on the starwarsccg.org home page gave the release date as 11 May 2012.<ref name="home81">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/ starwarsccg.org] home page with the Scoundrels banner, "Virtual Set 8.1 - Coming May 11th, 2012" (10 May 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20120510015711/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ Internet Archive].</ref>

== Discrepancies ==
* Printed as The Mandalorian, Father Of Fett; later released as [[Jango Fett, The Assassin]].<ref name="pdf" /><ref name="dl">[https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/DarkLegacy.json DarkLegacy.json] (swccg-card-json legacy card data). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020183346/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/DarkLegacy.json Internet Archive].</ref>
* Printed as Rebel Agent; later released as [[Kyle Katarn]].<ref name="pdf" /><ref name="ll">[https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/LightLegacy.json LightLegacy.json] (swccg-card-json legacy card data). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020183434/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/LightLegacy.json Internet Archive].</ref>
* Printed as Booster's Star Destroyer (V); later released as [[Errant Venture]].<ref name="pdf" /><ref name="ll" />
* Printed as Rebel Agent's Blaster Rifle; later released as [[Kyle Katarn's Blaster Rifle]].<ref name="pdf" /><ref name="ll" />
* [[There is Another|There Is Another]], a Defensive Shield printed in this release, is part of [[Virtual Shields]] in the legacy card data.<ref name="ll" />
* The alternate-image version [[Kyle Katarn (AI)]] on the [[Virtual Block 8]] card list is not in this release PDF.<ref name="pdf" />
* The alternate-image version [[Supreme Chancellor Valorum (V) (AI)]] on the [[Virtual Block 8]] card list is not in this release PDF.<ref name="pdf" />
* The alternate-image version [[Errant Venture (AI)]] on the [[Virtual Block 8]] card list is not in this release PDF.<ref name="pdf" />
* The alternate-image version [[Jango Fett, The Assassin (AI)]] on the [[Virtual Block 8]] card list is not in this release PDF.<ref name="pdf" />
